Instruction.description: Operands reference live state, never values specialized to the current mode.

chunk_frames.description: Samples per media chunk. Media positions and lengths use chunk units.

Ramp.description:
The first affected sample has `start`; sample `duration` and later have `target`.
Preserve the original domain across quantum boundaries and interrupted ramps.

range.description: Present for a read-only view; its offset is within the first chunk.
